intro.title: 🤖 AI Native Book on Humanoid Robotics
intro.description: Comprehensive Guide to Physical AI and Humanoid Robotics

module-1/chapter-1-ros2-architecture.title: 🤖 ROS 2 Architecture Fundamentals
module-1/chapter-1-ros2-architecture.description: Core Concepts: Nodes • Topics • Services • Actions • DDS

module-1/chapter-2-python-agents-rclpy.title: Python Agents and Robot Control
module-1/chapter-2-python-agents-rclpy.description: This chapter demonstrates how to use rclpy to connect Python agents with ROS 2 controllers, explaining message flow, lifecycle nodes, and control abstraction.

module-1/chapter-3-urdf-humanoids.title: Robot Modeling with URDF
module-1/chapter-3-urdf-humanoids.description: This chapter provides clear explanations of URDF (Unified Robot Description Format) structure for humanoid robots, including links, joints, sensors, coordinate frames, and preparing models for simulation.

module-2/chapter-1-physics-simulation-wi.title: Physics Simulation with Gazebo
module-2/chapter-1-physics-simulation-wi.description: This chapter covers simulating gravity, collisions, joint dynamics, world files, and integrating ROS 2 with Gazebo for humanoid robots.

module-2/chapter-2-high-fidelity-interac.title: High-Fidelity Interaction with Unity
module-2/chapter-2-high-fidelity-interac.description: This chapter covers Unity as a digital twin environment, real-time rendering, humanoid interaction scenarios, and syncing simulation state with ROS 2.

module-2/chapter-3-sensor-simulation-for.title: Sensor Simulation for Perception
module-2/chapter-3-sensor-simulation-for.description: This chapter covers simulating LiDAR, depth cameras, and IMUs, sensor noise models, data streams, and preparing perception inputs for AI pipelines.

module-2/glossary.title: Glossary
module-2/glossary.description: This glossary defines key terms used throughout the Digital Twin Simulation Module (Module 2).

module-3/chapter-1-nvidia-isaac-sim-and-.title: Chapter 1: NVIDIA Isaac Sim and Synthetic Data
module-3/chapter-1-nvidia-isaac-sim-and-.description: Learn how to use NVIDIA Isaac Sim for photorealistic simulation and synthetic data generation for training perception models

module-3/chapter-2-isaac-ros-and-acceler.title: Chapter 2: Isaac ROS and Accelerated Perception
module-3/chapter-2-isaac-ros-and-acceler.description: Learn how to use Isaac ROS for hardware-accelerated Visual SLAM (VSLAM) and perception pipelines with ROS 2 integration

module-3/chapter-3-navigation-with-nav2-.title: Chapter 3: Navigation with Nav2 for Humanoid Robots
module-3/chapter-3-navigation-with-nav2-.description: Learn how to adapt Nav2 for humanoid robot navigation, focusing on path planning, costmaps, and localization for bipedal locomotion
